intents.name: order_status
intents.description: Questions about order location, tracking, shipment progress, or delivery status.

intents.name: shipping_info
intents.description: Questions about shipping times, delivery options, or shipping estimates.
examples: How many business days is standard shipping?

intents.name: return_request
intents.description: Questions about return eligibility, return instructions, or how to start a return.
examples: How do I return an item?
Is this order eligible for return?
I need to send back my purchase

intents.name: refund_request
intents.description: Questions about refund eligibility, refund timing, or refund status.

intents.name: cancel_order
intents.description: Questions about canceling an order before shipment.
examples: Stop my order before it ships
How do I cancel an order?

intents.name: payment_issue
intents.description: Questions about failed payments, declined cards, duplicate charges, or billing issues.
examples: There is a billing issue on my account

intents.name: product_question
intents.description: Questions about product materials, sizing, features, or availability when information is in the knowledge base.
examples: What material is this jacket made from?
Does this product come in other sizes?
Can you tell me more about this item?
Is this product available in blue?

intents.name: complaint
intents.description: Customer dissatisfaction, frustration, or complaints about the shopping experience.
examples: I want to complain about my order
I am very unhappy with this experience

intents.name: speak_to_human
intents.description: Requests to talk to a real support agent or manager.
examples: I want to speak to a human
Connect me to a support agent
Let me talk to a real person

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.description: Requests unrelated to ShopSmart e-commerce customer support.

intents.name: unclear
intents.description: Very vague, incomplete, or underspecified requests that need clarification.
